observations: Nikon D3400 DSLR body is visible in photo 0.

risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a tool like 'myshuttercount' using the last photo taken.
Clear, well-lit close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements.
A photo of the battery labels and the charger.

proof_requests: Screenshot of the shutter count from the most recent photo.
Close-up photos of the front and rear lens glass.
Photos of the battery and charger to confirm they are original Nikon brand.
A short video showing the camera powering on, focusing, and taking a photo.
response.reason: The camera and lens are clearly identified. Although the seller claims low usage, the visible damage to the grip in photo 2 allows for a 'worst case' valuation as a heavily used unit.
